responsibility: Documents the vendored Rust log crate that provides a lightweight logging facade for embedded upstream components in the Polonius borrow-checking dependency stack. It explains the facade model, initialization expectations for executables, available logger backends, macro-based usage, and optional structured key-value logging, but it is reference documentation for the dependency rather than GCC frontend logging code.
same_name_distinction: This README.md is the one for the vendored log crate in vendor/log/, distinguishing it from the other README.md files by covering the Rust logging facade, logger initialization, and logging macros rather than datafrog, polonius-engine, or rustc-hash.
